summary: The media values.schema.json closes every level values.yaml defines. Helm 4.3.0 rejects storage.plex.subvolumeName in both lint and template, and accepts the defaults, the prd and dev values, and the injected --sets, with no network fetch. One advisory finding: the tests sample 7 of the 21 closed levels.

findings.summary: Unknown-key tests check 7 of 21 closed schema levels; removing additionalProperties at service.plex/storage.zfs leaves all tests green
